gp.text: Gross profit for the fiscal 2025 quarter increased by $1.2 million to $6.0 million, and gross margins increased to 31.5% of sales compared to 29.9% of sales in the fiscal 2024 quarter. The increases in gross profit and gross margins were primarily related to the overall increase in sales, direct air cooling product mix and new market penetration.

tax.text: For the fiscal 2025 and 2024 quarters, we recorded income tax provision of $135,000 and $3,649,000, respectively. The effective tax rate was (122.7%) for the fiscal 2025 quarter, compared to (564.7%) for the fiscal 2024 quarter. The change in the effective tax rate from the fiscal 2025 quarter to fiscal 2024 quarter was primarily driven by the effects of the change in valuation allowance, research and development credits, state income taxes, and other expected permanent differences.

net.text: For the fiscal 2025 quarter, net loss was $0.2 million and fully diluted loss per share was $0.02, compared to a net loss of $4.3 million and fully diluted loss per share of $0.41 for the fiscal 2024 quarter. For the fiscal 2025 quarter, the diluted weighted average shares outstanding were 10,669,608 as compared to 10,495,548 for the fiscal 2024 quarter.

ocf.text: In the six months ended April 30, 2025, we generated $2.8 million of cash in our operating activities. This net inflow of cash is primarily related to a decrease in inventories of $2.2 million as a result of better inventory management and supply chain conditions improving allowing us to carry less inventory on hand, $1.2 million from depreciation and amortization, $1.0 million from the change in accounts payable, $0.4 million from stock-based compensation expense, $1.6 million from the change in accrued expenses, $0.1 million from bad debt expense and $87,000 from amortization of debt issuance costs. The cash usage was primarily due to the net loss of $0.5 million, the change in accounts receivable of $3.0 million, the change in other current assets of $0.1 million, right-of-use assets of $0.2 million, $34,000 tax payments on cancelled shares of restricted stock and $3,000 from deferred income taxes.

lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

Sales through independent distributors accounted for approximately 28% of our net sales for the fiscal year ended October 31, 2025.

For the year ended October 31, 2025, a wireless provider customer accounted for approximately 10% of total sales and approximately 26% of the total net accounts receivable balance, and an aerospace customer accounted for less than 10% of total sales and approximately 18% of the total net accounts receivable balance.

For the year ended October 31, 2024, a wireless provider customer and a distributor customer both accounted for less than 10% of total sales, and accounted for approximately 15% and 10% of the total net accounts receivable balance, respectively.

Sales to customers located outside the United States, either directly or through U.S. and foreign distributors, accounted for approximately 8% and 9% of our net sales during the years ended October 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

Revenues generated from our interconnect products were 31% of the Company’s total sales for fiscal 2025, revenues from our custom cabling products were 32% of the Company’s total sales for fiscal 2025, and revenues from our integrated systems were 37% of total sales for fiscal 2025.
